notes.blurb: Dark volcanic stone and pale ash-bleached wood. Hard geometry, small windows, the light let in deliberately rather than generously.
notes.construction: walls of coursed dark stone, pale timber only at openings and eaves, so every window reads as a bright cut in a dark mass
notes.ground:
buildings sunk a storey into the slope on the uphill side, on a footing of dark
deepslate brick.
notes.roofs: hip (1,2), tight to the wall, no overhang to speak of
notes.signature: a single tall slit window running most of the height of one wall
